instruction: Remove the last two applications from your favorites dock.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing the last two apps (Vim and Chrome) from the favorites list, keeping only Thunderbird. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GNOME favorites list using 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps'
Metric 'check_gnome_favorite_apps' correctly parses the string output to list and compares both length and content
Expected value ['thunderbird.desktop'] is semantically correct - after removing last two apps (vim.desktop, google-chrome.desktop) from initial 3-app list, only thunderbird.desktop remains
Complete coverage: instruction requires removing last two apps, evaluator verifies final state contains only the correct remaining app
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: accesses rule['expected'] directly (expected.type='rule' means framework passes rules dict directly)
Data flow is correct: gsettings output string -> parsed to list -> compared with expected list
No postconfig needed: gsettings can read system settings directly without UI reopening
